command:
export PATH=/var/jb/usr/bin:/var/jb/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/usr/sbin:/bin:/sbin
PRE_WS=$(launchctl list 2>/dev/null | awk '$3=="UIKitApplication:com.macwsguide.windowserver"{print $1}')
PRE_TCCD=$(launchctl list 2>/dev/null | awk '$3=="com.macwsguide.tccd-system"{print $1}')
echo "PRE_WS=$PRE_WS PRE_TCCD=$PRE_TCCD"
[ -n "$PRE_WS" ] || { echo NO_WS; exit 1; }
kill -TERM "$PRE_WS"
echo "KILLED=$PRE_WS"
i=0
while [ $i -lt 30 ]; do
  i=$((i+1)); sleep 5
  NOW_WS=$(launchctl list 2>/dev/null | awk '$3=="UIKitApplication:com.macwsguide.windowserver"{print $1}')
  NOW_TCCD=$(launchctl list 2>/dev/null | awk '$3=="com.macwsguide.tccd-system"{print $1}')
  echo "T+$((i*5))s WS=$NOW_WS TCCD=$NOW_TCCD"
  if [ -n "$NOW_WS" ] && [ "$NOW_WS" != "$PRE_WS" ] && [ -n "$NOW_TCCD" ] && [ "$NOW_TCCD" != "$PRE_TCCD" ]; then
     echo RECOVERY_BOTH_REPLACED; break
  fi
done
echo "=== watchdog"
grep -E "reconnecting|recovered|tccd|did not recover|replacement WindowServer|GUI clients reconnected" /var/jb/var/mobile/macos_gui_watchdog.log | tail -12
echo "=== tccd print"
launchctl print user/501/com.macwsguide.tccd-system 2>&1 | grep -E "state =|pid =|com.apple.macosbooter" | head -6
echo "=== final ps"
ps -axo pid,etime,command | grep -E "Resources/WindowServer|tccd system" | grep -v grep
